title: Update: my AI stock trader, $1,000 paper account is now at $1,137
author: Dear_Station_75
selftext:
Quick update for everyone who’s been following along. When I posted in August, the paper account was at $1,070. As of today (Nov 4) it’s at $1,137.19, and today alone was up $36.51 (+3.32%). I started the account with $1,000 on July 1, so that’s roughly 13.7% since the start.

I’m now 5 months into running this agent, and I want to be straight about what this is and isn’t. It’s still 100% paper trading, and 5 months is a small sample. The chart wasn’t a straight line up. It dipped under $1,000 early on, drifted sideways through September, and only started climbing again in the last few weeks. Every bug I’ve fixed along the way is a big reason it looks better now than it did then. I still audit every trade it makes, every day. The account is also almost fully invested right now, with only $13.30 in cash.

A lot of you asked what you’d like to see next, so I’m taking the series to its own pages. I’ll be covering the basics of how AI trading works: how an AI can be put to work on trading decisions, the bugs and mistakes that taught me the most, and the lessons from my 5 months of real testing. I’ll keep the architecture and rulebook light, and I won’t be sharing my full strategy, since that’s what I’ve spent months building. What you will get is an honest look at the process from someone who came in with 5 years of trading and zero coding background.

I’m launching it across all platforms under the same name:

* YouTube: ThebasicsofAITrading
* X: basicsaitrading
* Instagram: basicsofaitrading
* TikTok: thebasicsofaitrading

If you want to learn how this works, follow along. And if there’s a specific topic you want covered first, tell me in the comments.
